How to play

  2. Light pulses move automatically from emitters
  3. Route each pulse to its matching receiver

Welcome to Prism Relay

Rotate junctions to guide colored light to its matching receiver before time runs out.

◈
1 — Rotate

Click or tap a junction. Each tap rotates 90°. Use R or Space for keyboard.

●→
2 — Route

Cyan pulses need cyan receivers. Same for magenta & amber. Straight through or around bends.

⚡
3 — Combo

Deliver quickly to build combo. Each streak adds +50% score. A miss resets it.

Level goals: Level 1 needs 6 deliveries in 45s. Higher levels add a third color and obstacles. You can restart anytime.
